player_prompt.intro:
You are playing PegJump. Jump one peg over another into an empty hole, removing the jumped peg.
Goal: finish with exactly **one** peg left. Action format: e.g. '[4 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sebopeho sa mantsoe se fosahetseng. Sebelisa [i->j] .
invalid_move.illegal_move: Ho falla ka tsela e seng molaong.

outcome.win: E rarollotsoe ka thupa e le 'ngoe feela!
